name: update_schema_test
description: VillageSQL test extension for demonstrating on-disk representation migration across an ALTER EXTENSION version bump. v2 keeps MYTYPE (4-byte int, backward-compatible with v1) and adds MYTYPE_V2 (8-byte int) plus a mytype_to_v2 VDF that converts MYTYPE values to MYTYPE_V2.
author: VillageSQL Community
